statements.text: Lastly, I joined a number of my colleagues in cosponsoring a bipartisan amendment that would establish the United States-Israel Artificial Intelligence Center to leverage the experience, knowledge, and expertise of our two countries to develop more robust research and development cooperation in the field of artificial intelligence.
statements.context: House floor remarks by Representative John Rose ahead of FY2024 NDAA consideration, urging the Rules Committee to make his amendments in order.

statements.text: There have been some concerns that consumers are limited in recourse against unfavorable decisions made by artificial intelligence. [...] However, the Fair Credit Reporting Act and the Equal Credit Opportunity Act regulate adverse action when a creditor acts against a consumer based on their credit report.
statements.context: Spoken during a hearing titled 'AI Innovation Explored: Insights into AI Applications in Financial Services and Housing,' addressed to a witness named Mr. Reynolds.

statements.text: Thanks to artificial intelligence models, ORNL will be able to serve more customers and provide customers with a better experience overall. [...] hope that as we discuss and debate artificial intelligence regulation, we do not hamper innovation.
statements.context: Opening remarks by Rep. Rose at a House Financial Services Committee hearing on AI applications in financial services and housing.

statements.text: as financial institutions increasingly leverage artificial intelligence to better identify suspicious activity reports, will it not be imperative that they receive strong feedback from Financial Crimes Enforcement, or FinCEN, regarding the suspicious activity reports submitted so that their models are appropriately calibrated?
statements.context: Mr. Rose asks a question during a congressional hearing on AI applications in financial services and housing.

statements.text: I want to start with you, Dr. Cox. Could you please describe the concept of technological singularity and share your perspective on whether you believe AI will achieve singularity and provide an estimate on the possible timeframe for this development?
statements.context: House Financial Services Committee hearing on AI in the U.S. financial system.

statements.text: We already see—without the benefit of AI, we see cash transactions being discriminated against in a number of ways. It is a very real concern to me. [...] with the increasing prevalence of artificial intelligence, it is clear that AI-assisted fraud will likely escalate rapidly, employing novel tactics to deceive consumers. [...] How can private companies and industry stakeholders collaborate proactively to anticipate and combat the evolving threat of AI-assisted fraud?
statements.context: Hearing on AI in the U.S. financial system where a lawmaker questions a witness about AI-driven fraud.

statements.text: How can we ensure that AI does not discriminate against individuals who use cash? Additionally, what measures can be taken to prevent AI systems from falsely flagging cash transactions as suspicious, thereby avoiding undue pressure on companies and regulators to favor cashless payments over cash transactions?
statements.context: Hearing on AI in the U.S. financial system, where a lawmaker questions an expert witness about AI bias against cash transactions.
